data.name: Nimika
data.gender_notes: Nimika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nimika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimisha', which means 'instant'. In Hindu mythology, Nimika is the goddess of fertility and motherhood. She is believed to bless her devotees with abundance and prosperity. The name Nimika carries the meaning “Goddess of fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nimika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of creation and the blessings of the mother goddess.
data.etymology: Nimika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimika total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
